text:
marie: starting canary rollout for v2.7.0 -> canary-A (5% traffic). rolling now, keep an eye on p95 and 5xx. will post rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Deploy start confirmed: v2.7.0 -> canary-A. id=db-1775. Canary window 15m. Auto-rollback currently OFF for perf regressions. Metrics tracked: p95, error-rate, request-rate. Alerts -> #eng-oncall.

kevin: thanks. quick q — what are the exact rollback thresholds we want today? last time we used p95>2.0s or 5xx>0.8% for sustained interval.

sarah: +1 to having explicit numbers. add "sustained" rule: 3 consecutive minutes breaching threshold before triggering anything. also, for anything that looks like data corruption or leak, manual only.

anil: note: this release includes a quantization change on the decoder path. i'd vote for manual rollback for the first 30m unless it's a hard failure. also pre-notify CS.

marie: proposal: auto-rollback ON for hard failures (5xx > 1% sustained 2m). perf regressions (p95 > 2.0s) -> manual rollback required, but deploy-bot will annotate and open a rollback runbook. fallback pin: v2.6.5. thoughts?

jessica: CS: please notify top customers if we roll back. i'll draft a short template in #customer-success and standby.

kevin: command to set policy (example):
```
deploy-bot set-policy --id db-1775 --auto-rollback "5xx>1%::120s" --perf-manual "p95>2.0s::180s" --fallback v2.6.5
```

sarah: LGTM. also add a short release note: "v2.7.0: improved batching; decoder quant changes; watch p95 on long sequences."

ops-bot: baseline metrics for canary: p95=480ms, error-rate=0.05%, token-rate consistent. I'll post 1m snapshots.

deploy-bot: Canary tasks running. Will escalate to #eng-oncall and trigger auto-rollback if thresholds met. :bell:

[~6 minutes later]
marie: seeing p95 spike ~2.3s on canary nodes 2/5, errors steady ~0.06%. :eyes:

kevin: can you paste a short trace or logs from the affected pod?

marie: logs snippet:
```
2026-07-18T17:34:12Z node-2 kernel: kv_cache: evict index=12 size=49
2026-07-18T17:34:12Z runtime: aten_op slow path 1.72s seq_len=1024
2026-07-18T17:34:13Z app: request_id=abc123 latency=2290ms
```

sarah: looks like KV cache eviction thrash on long sequences. suggests memory pressure. options: restart canary pods with increased cache, or roll back. since errors aren't spiking, prefer remediation first.

anil: agree. scale canary pool + flush KV cache, wait 5m, if p95 still >2.0s after 10m then manual rollback to v2.6.5.

kevin: running scale now:
```
kubectl scale deployment/rw-runtime-canary -n inference --replicas=7
# and flush cache via admin API
curl -X POST https://internal-admin/rw/cache/flush?canary=1
```

ops-bot: scaling event processed. replicas -> 7. Monitoring metrics.

[~3 minutes later]
ops-bot: p95 dropped to 630ms after scale and cache flush.

jessica: CS notified top customers with the "heads-up" template. no rollbacks triggered.

marie: leaving auto-rollback OFF for perf for this run. we'll keep the manual policy in place and monitor for the remainder of the 15m window. thanks all. :thumbsup:
